correctness.rationale: The proof is a direct implication chain. HOMFLY–PT specialization at a=1 gives the Conway polynomial, so Alexander span is at most HOMFLY z-degree. Failure of either candidate puts the corresponding concordance invariant strictly above that z-degree. Ozsvath–Szabo and Rasmussen bound the same invariants by twice the smooth four-ball genus, which is at most twice the Seifert genus. Alexander span and twice the genus are even, so strict genus defect is at least two. Fibered knots have Alexander degree exactly twice genus.
